videos.description: ⚽🔵 Introducing London Colney's New Mascot – Evan! 🔵⚽ Everyone at London Colney is delighted to welcome our newest mascot, Evan! 💙 With a huge smile, plenty of confidence, and proudly wearing the famous blue and white colours, Evan is already showing what it means to be part of the London Colney family. From leading on the players to cheering in the stands, he's ready to bring energy, excitement, and plenty of team spirit to every matchday. Evan's passion for football shines through, and we can't wait to see him leading the fans, encouraging the team, and creating unforgettable memories throughout the season. Make sure to give Evan a big London Colney welcome when you see him around the club! 👏⚽ #LondonColney #NewMascot #FutureBlueboy #FootballFamily #GrassrootsFootball
